fields.climate: arctic to subarctic; cool summers, cold winters
fields.terrain: flat to gradually sloping icecap covers all but a narrow, mountainous, barren, rocky coast
fields.hazards: continuous permafrost over northern two-thirds of the island
fields.resources: coal, iron ore, lead, zinc, molybdenum, diamonds, gold, platinum, niobium, tantalite, uranium, fish, seals, whales, hydropower, possible oil and gas
fields.exports: fish, shellfish, processed crustaceans, ships, precious stones
fields.industries: fish processing (mainly shrimp and Greenland halibut), anorthosite and ruby mining, handicrafts, hides and skins, small shipyards
fields.religions: Evangelical Lutheran, traditional Inuit spiritual beliefs

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Parliament of Greenland or Inatsisartut)

fields.legal: Denmark's laws apply in some areas, and Greenland's law for the remainder
